title: AreaOfInterest
description: A user-defined rectangular Area of Interest (AOI) for a flood risk analysis request. Coordinates travel over the API in EPSG:4326 (lon/lat degrees). The AOI is not required to be square. Area is computed server-side by reprojecting the bbox to EPSG:32645 (UTM Zone 45N) — never computed directly from EPSG:4326 degrees, since degree-based area is not metrically meaningful. See SPEC.md, 'CRS convention'.

bbox.description: [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] in EPSG:4326 decimal degrees (minx/maxx = longitude, miny/maxy = latitude). A rectangle; width and height need not be equal.

crs.description: Fixed. All AOI coordinates in API requests/responses are EPSG:4326.

area_km2.description: Computed area of the AOI in square kilometers. MUST be computed by reprojecting the bbox to EPSG:32645 (UTM 45N) and measuring there, not from raw EPSG:4326 degrees. Populated by the server; not supplied by the client.

max_area_km2.description: The area cap a request's AOI must not exceed, in km². Default 500 km², chosen to comfortably cover the Kathmandu Valley (~ 665 km² basin / ~ 350-400 km² urbanized core, depending on the boundary used) while bounding compute cost. A request whose computed area_km2 exceeds max_area_km2 must be rejected with a clear validation error rather than silently clipped.
